# Bidyut Kumar Bhowmick

> Full Stack & Mobile Developer based in West Bengal, India, building web applications, cross-platform mobile apps, APIs, and custom digital products with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, React Native, Expo, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Prisma ORM.

Bidyut Kumar Bhowmick is available for full-time engineering roles, freelance builds, custom websites, CRMs, and mobile app development. He holds a BCA from Bengal Institute of Technology & Management (BITM) and speaks Bengali (native), English (professional working proficiency), and Hindi (conversational).
